4 اقنت He stood long in the performance of the divinely-appointed act of prayer. (O, K.) [And قَنَتَ has the same, or nearly the same, meaning; as is shown above.] ―
-b2- Also, [like قَنَتَ عَلَى عَدُوِّهِ,] He cursed his enemy. (IAar, O, K.) ―
-b3- See also 1, last quarter, in two places. ―
-b4- Also He lowered, humbled, or submitted, himself to God. (IAar, O, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
